name: couju
description: OneMore: less planning, more playing. Bilingual scheduling for independent groups of friends.

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n api,h5 -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @couju/server" "npm run dev:h5 -w @couju/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:h5 -w @couju/client
scripts.build:weapp: npm run build:core && npm run build:weapp:online -w @couju/client
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @couju/server
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @couju/core && npm run test -w @couju/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @couju/core && npm run typecheck -w @couju/server && npm run typecheck -w @couju/client
